Tern Queue pilot review
Record: doc-018
Date: 2025-04-19
Collection: Fictional queue-study archive

Exhibit team review of the paper-token queue game for a small display. The review approves the size of printed cards and the arrangement of the demonstration table. “Tern Queue” is the exhibit's caption.

No software queue, persistence behavior, restart experiment or transport latency was evaluated. The exhibit's invitation wording is [[doc-019]]. The shared-title collision is listed in [[doc-016]].
